title: SID MEDICOS moves to expand LemonBottle distribution and strengthen supply in Japan
summary: New distribution channels will build on the brand’s existing network in Japan, with a phased expansion planned according to regional demand and distribution conditions; plans also include stronger product information and authenticity guidance, alongside global portfolio development in aftercare and cooling skincare

extraction.key_fact: SID MEDICOS가 일본에서 LemonBottle 유통을 넓히고 공급을 강화한다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: SID MEDICOS moves to expand LemonBottle distribution and strengthen supply in Japan
